mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 70 degrees under fair conditions at Verona City Hall. If you look toward the west over Mount Horeb at 6:32 PM, you can catch the International Space Station traveling toward the northeast near Madison, rising about halfway up the sky.

In city news, the Plan Commission is meeting December 7 to discuss the Liberty Business Park project. Additionally, the Recreation Department has posted the latest standings for all league sports, and general election notices are now available for review.

It is a busy weekend! Today you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, enjoy Lake Lou-ee's music series or the John Denver tribute show at the Verona Area High School Fine Arts Center.

Looking at the weekly police report, on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I after finding him unresponsive in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today is the perfect day for a scoop of Caramel Cashew at Culver's, and since they are open until 10:30 PM, there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
